verses.text: Di ark of di Lord dey for di country of di Philistines seven months.
Di Philistines call di priests and di diviners, talk say, “Wetin we go do with di ark of di Lord? Show us how we suppose send am go im place.”
Dem talk say, “If una send away di ark of di God of Israel, no send am empty; but una must return trespass offering to am. Den una go get healing, and una go know why im hand never leave una.”

Den dem talk say, “Wetin be di trespass offering wey we go return to am?” Dem talk say, “Five golden tumours, and five golden mice, according to di number of di ogas of di Philistines; because one plague dey on una all, and on una ogas.
So una go make images of una tumours, and images of una mice wey dey spoil di land; and una go give glory to di God of Israel. Maybe e go make im hand light on una, and on una gods, and on una land.
Why una dey harden una hearts, as di Egyptians and Pharaoh harden dem hearts? When e do wonderful things among dem, dem no let di people go, and dem leave?
So now take and prepare one new cart, and two milk cows wey yoke never come on; and tie di cows to di cart, and bring dem calves go house from dem;
and take di ark of di Lord, put am on di cart; and put di jewels of gold, wey una dey return to am for trespass offering, inside one box for im side; and send am go, make e go.
Look, if e go up by di way of im own border to Beth Shemesh, den na im do us dis big evil; but if no, den we go know say no be im hand strike us. Na chance happen to us.”
Di men do so, and take two milk cows, tie dem to di cart, and shut dem calves for house;
and dem put di ark of di Lord on di cart, and di box with di golden mice and di images of dem tumours.

Di cows take di straight way, di way to Beth Shemesh; dem dey waka for di highway, dey cry as dem dey go, and dem no turn aside to di right hand or to di left; and di ogas of di Philistines follow dem reach di border of Beth Shemesh.
Di people of Beth Shemesh dey reap dem wheat harvest for di valley; and dem lift up dem eyes, see di ark, and rejoice to see am.
Di cart come into di field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stand dere, wia big stone dey: and dem split di wood of di cart, and offer di cows as burnt offering to di Lord.

Di Levites bring down di ark of di Lord, and di box wey dey with am, wey di jewels of gold dey inside, put dem on di big stone: and di men of Beth Shemesh offer burnt offerings and make sacrifices dat same day to di Lord.
When di five ogas of di Philistines see am, dem return to Ekron dat same day.
Dis na di golden tumours wey di Philistines return as trespass offering to di Lord: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

and di golden mice, according to di number of all di cities of di Philistines wey belong to di five ogas, both fortified cities and country villages, even to di big stone wey dem set down di ark of di Lord on, wey remain till today for di field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
E strike some of di men of Beth Shemesh, because dem look inside di ark of di Lord, e strike 50,070 men of di people; and di people mourn, because di Lord don strike di people with big slaughter.
Di men of Beth Shemesh talk say, “Who fit stand before di Lord, dis holy God? To who e go go up from us?”
Dem send messengers to di people wey dey Kiriath Jearim, talk say, “Di Philistines don bring back di ark of di Lord. Come down, and carry am go up to una.”
Di men of Kiriath Jearim come, carry di ark of di Lord go up, bring am enter di house of Abinadab on di hill, and consecrate im pikin man Eleazar to keep di ark of di Lord.
From di day wey di ark stay for Kiriath Jearim, di time long; because e reach 20 years: and all di house of Israel mourn go di Lord.

Samuel speak to all di house of Israel, talk say, “If una dey truly return to di Lord with all una hearts, den put away di foreign gods and di Ashtaroth from among una, and prepare una hearts for di Lord, and serve am only; and e go deliver una from di hand of di Philistines.”
Den di pikin dem of Israel put away di Baals and di Ashtaroth, and serve di Lord only.
Samuel talk say, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I go pray for una to di Lord.”
Dem gather together to Mizpah, draw water, pour am out before di Lord, fast dat day, and talk dere say, “We don sin against di Lord.” Samuel judge di pikin dem of Israel for Mizpah.
When di Philistines hear say di pikin dem of Israel don gather together for Mizpah, di ogas of di Philistines go up against Israel. When di pikin dem of Israel hear am, dem fear di Philistines.
Di pikin dem of Israel talk to Samuel say, “No stop to cry to di Lord our God for us, so that e go save us from di hand of di Philistines.”
Samuel take one suckling lamb, offer am as whole burnt offering to di Lord: and Samuel cry to di Lord for Israel; and di Lord answer am.
As Samuel dey offer di burnt offering, di Philistines come near to battle against Israel; but di Lord thunder with big thunder dat day on di Philistines, and confuse dem; and dem lose before Israel.
Di men of Israel go out of Mizpah, chase di Philistines, and strike dem, until dem reach under Beth Kar.
Den Samuel take one stone, set am between Mizpah and Shen, and call im name Ebenezer, talk say, “Di Lord don help us reach now.”
So dem subdue di Philistines, and dem no come inside di border of Israel again: and di hand of di Lord dey against di Philistines all di days of Samuel.
Di cities wey di Philistines take from Israel return to Israel, from Ekron reach Gath; and Israel deliver im border from di hand of di Philistines. Peace dey between Israel and di Amorites.
Samuel judge Israel all di days of im life.
E dey go from year to year for circuit to Bethel and Gilgal and Mizpah; and e dey judge Israel for all dem places.
Im return na to Ramah, because im house dey dere; and dere e dey judge Israel; and e build altar dere to di Lord.
When Samuel don old, e make im pikin man dem judges over Israel.
Now di name of im firstborn na Joel; and di name of im second na Abijah: dem dey judge for Beersheba.
Im pikin man dem no waka for im ways, but turn aside after dishonest gain, take bribes, and pervert justice.
Den all di elders of Israel gather demself together, and come to Samuel for Ramah.
Dem talk to am say, “Look, you don old, and your pikin man dem no dey waka for your ways. Now make king for us to judge us like all di nations.”
But di thing no please Samuel, when dem talk say, “Give us king to judge us.” Samuel pray to di Lord.
Di Lord talk to Samuel say, “Listen to di voice of di people for all wey dem tell you; because dem no reject you, but dem reject me, so that I no go be king over dem.
According to all di works wey dem don do since di day wey I bring dem up from Egypt reach today, how dem don forsake me, and serve other gods, na so dem dey do you too.
So now listen to dem voice. But you must warn dem solemnly, and show dem di way of di king wey go reign over dem.”
Samuel tell all di words of di Lord to di people wey ask am for king.
E talk say, “Dis go be di way of di king wey go reign over una: e go take una pikin man dem, and appoint dem to imself, for im chariots, and to be im horsemen; and dem go run before im chariots.

E go appoint dem to am as captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and e go assign some to plough im ground, and to reap im harvest, and to make im instruments of war, and di instruments of im chariots.
E go take una pikin woman dem to be perfumers, and cooks, and bakers.
E go take una fields, and una vineyards, and una olive groves, even di best of dem, and give dem to im servants.
E go take di tenth of una seed, and of una vineyards, and give am to im officers, and to im servants.
E go take una male servants, and una female servants, and una best young men, and una donkeys, and put dem to im work.
E go take di tenth of una flocks; and una go be im servants.
Una go cry out for dat day because of una king wey una don choose for una; and di Lord no go hear una for dat day.”
But di people no wan listen to di voice of Samuel; and dem talk say, “No, but we go get king over us,
so that we too go be like all di nations; and so that our king go judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
Samuel hear all di words of di people, and e repeat dem for di ears of di Lord.
Di Lord talk to Samuel say, “Listen to dem voice, and make king for dem.” Samuel talk to di men of Israel say, “Make everybody go im city.”
Now one man dey from Benjamin, im name na Kish, di pikin of Abiel, di pikin of Zeror, di pikin of Becorath, di pikin of Aphiah, di pikin of one man of Benjamin, one mighty man of valour.
E get one pikin man, im name na Saul, one handsome young man. Nobody dey among di pikin dem of Israel wey more handsome pass am. From im shoulders go up, e tall pass any of di people.
Di donkeys of Kish, Saul papa, lost. Kish talk to Saul im pikin man say, “Please take one of di servants with you, and rise, go find di donkeys.”

E pass through di hill country of Ephraim, and pass through di land of Shalishah, but dem no find dem. Den dem pass through di land of Shaalim, and dem no dey dere. E pass through di land of di men of Benjamin, but dem no find dem.
When dem reach di land of Zuph, Saul talk to im servant wey dey with am say, “Come, make we return, so that my papa no go stop to care about di donkeys, and begin worry about us.”
E talk to am say, “Look now, man of God dey for dis city, and na man wey dem honour. All wey e talk dey surely happen. Now make we go dere. Maybe e fit tell us di way wey we suppose go.”
Den Saul talk to im servant say, “But, look, if we go, wetin we go carry give di man? Because di bread don finish for our vessels, and no present dey to carry give di man of God. Wetin we get?”
Di servant answer Saul again, talk say, “Look, I get for my hand di fourth part of one shekel of silver. I go give dat one to di man of God, to tell us our way.”
For earlier times for Israel, when man go inquire of God, e dey talk say, “Come, make we go to di seer;” because di one wey dem dey call prophet now, dem dey call am seer before.
Den Saul talk to im servant say, “You talk well. Come, make we go.” So dem go to di city wia di man of God dey.
As dem dey go up di slope to di city, dem meet young women wey dey go out to draw water, and talk to dem say, “Di seer dey here?”
Dem answer dem say, “E dey; look, e dey before una. Hurry now, because e don come into di city today; because di people get sacrifice today for di high place.

As soon as una enter di city, una go find am, before e go up to di high place to eat; because di people no go eat until e come, because e dey bless di sacrifice; and after dat di ones wey dem invite go eat. So now go up; because for dis time una go find am.”
Dem go up to di city; and as dem enter di city, look, Samuel come out toward dem, to go up to di high place.
Now di Lord don reveal to Samuel one day before Saul come, talk say,

“Tomorrow about dis time I go send you one man from di land of Benjamin, and you go anoint am to be prince over my people Israel; and e go save my people from di hand of di Philistines: because I don look my people, because dem cry don come to me.”
When Samuel see Saul, di Lord talk to am say, “Look, di man wey I talk to you about! Dis one go get authority over my people.”
Den Saul come near to Samuel for di gate, and talk say, “Please tell me wia di seer house dey.”
Samuel answer Saul, “I na di seer. Go up before me to di high place, because una go eat with me today. For morning I go let you go, and I go tell you all wetin dey for your heart.
As for your donkeys wey lost three days ago, no put your mind on dem, because dem don find dem. For who be all wetin dey desirable for Israel? E no be for you, and for all your papa house?”
Saul answer, “I no be man of Benjamin, from di smallest of di tribes of Israel? And my family na di least of all di families of di tribe of Benjamin? Why den you dey speak to me like dis?”
Samuel take Saul and im servant, bring dem enter di guest room, and make dem sit for di best place among di ones wey dem invite, wey be about 30 persons.
Samuel talk to di cook say, “Bring di portion wey I give you, wey I talk say, ‘Set am by you.’”

Di cook take up di thigh, and wetin dey on am, and put am before Saul. Samuel talk say, “Look, wetin dem reserve! Put am before yourself and eat; because dem don keep am for you for di appointed time, since I talk say, ‘I don invite di people.’” So Saul eat with Samuel dat day.
When dem come down from di high place enter di city, e talk with Saul for di roof.
Dem rise early; and about when day dey break, Samuel call Saul for di roof, talk say, “Get up, so that I go send you go.” Saul rise, and di two of dem go out, e and Samuel, outside.

As dem dey go down reach di end of di city, Samuel talk to Saul say, “Tell di servant make e go ahead before us,” and di servant go ahead, “but you stand still for dis time, so that I go make you hear di word of God.”
Den Samuel take di vial of oil, pour am on im head, kiss am, and talk say, “Di Lord don anoint you to be prince over im inheritance, no be so?

When you don leave me today, den you go find two men by Rachel tomb, for di border of Benjamin for Zelzah; and dem go tell you, ‘Dem don find di donkeys wey you go find. Look, your papa don stop to care about di donkeys, and e dey worry about you, dey talk, “Wetin I go do for my pikin man?”’

Den you go go forward from dere, and you go reach di oak of Tabor; and three men go meet you dere dey go up to God for Bethel, one dey carry three young goats, and another dey carry three loaves of bread, and another dey carry container of wine:
and dem go greet you, give you two loaves of bread; wey you go receive from dem hand.

After dat you go reach di hill of God, wia di garrison of di Philistines dey: and e go happen say, when you don reach di city, you go meet one band of prophets wey dey come down from di high place with lyre, tambourine, pipe, and harp before dem; and dem go dey prophesy:
and di Lord Spirit go come on you with power, and you go prophesy with dem, and you go turn to another man.
Make e be say when dis signs don come to you, you do wetin suitable for di time; because God dey with you.

You go go down before me to Gilgal; and look, I go come down to you, to offer burnt offerings, and to make sacrifices of peace offerings. You go wait seven days, until I come to you, and show you wetin you go do.”
E happen say, when e turn im back to leave Samuel, God give am another heart: and all dem signs happen dat day.
When dem reach di hill, look, one band of prophets meet am; and God Spirit come on am with power, and e prophesy among dem.
When all wey know am before see say, look, e dey prophesy with di prophets, den di people talk to one another say, “Wetin don happen to di pikin man of Kish? Saul dey among di prophets too?”
One man from dat place answer, “Who be dem papa?” So e become proverb, “Saul dey among di prophets too?”
When e finish to prophesy, e come to di high place.
Saul uncle talk to am and to im servant say, “Wia una go?” E talk say, “To find di donkeys; and when we see say dem no dey found, we come to Samuel.”
Saul uncle talk say, “Please tell me wetin Samuel talk to una.”
Saul talk to im uncle say, “E tell us plainly say dem don find di donkeys.” But about di matter of di kingdom, wey Samuel speak about, e no tell am.
Samuel call di people together to di Lord for Mizpah;

and e talk to di pikin dem of Israel say, “Di Lord, God of Israel, talk say, ‘I bring Israel up from Egypt, and I deliver una from di hand of di Egyptians, and from di hand of all di kingdoms wey dey oppress una.’

But una don reject una God today, wey imself dey save una from all una calamities and una distresses; and una don talk to am say, ‘No, set king over us.’ So now present una self before di Lord by una tribes, and by una thousands.”
So Samuel bring all di tribes of Israel near, and dem pick di tribe of Benjamin.
E bring di tribe of Benjamin near by dem families, and dem pick di family of di Matrites; and dem pick Saul di pikin of Kish: but when dem find am, dem no fit see am.
So dem ask di Lord again, “One man still dey wey go come here?” Di Lord answer, “Look, e don hide imself among di baggage.”
Dem run go bring am from dere; and when e stand among di people, e tall pass any of di people from im shoulders go up.
Samuel talk to all di people say, “Una see di one wey di Lord don choose, say nobody like am among all di people?” All di people shout, talk say, “Make di king live long!”
Den Samuel tell di people di regulations of di kingdom, and write am for one book, and put am before di Lord. Samuel send all di people go, every man to im house.
Saul too go im house for Gibeah; and di army go with am, wey God don touch dem hearts.
But some wicked men talk say, “How dis man go take save us?” Dem despise am, and dem no bring am any tribute. But e keep quiet.
Den Nahash di Ammonite go up, camp against Jabesh Gilead: and all di men of Jabesh talk to Nahash say, “Make covenant with us, and we go serve you.”
Nahash di Ammonite talk to dem say, “For dis condition I go make am with una, say make una pull out all una right eyes; and I go put am as reproach on all Israel.”
Di elders of Jabesh talk to am say, “Give us seven days, so that we go send messengers to all di borders of Israel. Den, if nobody dey wey go save us, we go come out to you.”
Den di messengers come to Gibeah of Saul, and speak dis words for di ears of di people: and all di people lift up dem voice, and weep.
Look, Saul dey come follow di oxen from di field; and Saul talk say, “Wetin dey wrong with di people, say dem dey weep?” Dem tell am di words of di men of Jabesh.
God Spirit come on Saul with power when e hear dem words, and im anger burn strongly.

E take one yoke of oxen, cut dem to pieces, and send dem go all di borders of Israel by di hand of messengers, talk say, “Anybody wey no come out follow Saul and Samuel, na so dem go do im oxen.” Fear of di Lord fall on di people, and dem come out like one man.
E count dem for Bezek; and di pikin dem of Israel na 300,000, and di men of Judah na 30,000.

Dem talk to di messengers wey come say, “Dis na wetin una go tell di men of Jabesh Gilead: ‘Tomorrow, by di time wey sun don hot, una go get deliverance.’” Di messengers come tell di men of Jabesh; and dem glad.
So di men of Jabesh talk say, “Tomorrow we go come out to una, and una go do with us all wetin good for una eyes.”

E happen di next day say Saul divide di people into three companies; and dem enter di middle of di camp for morning watch, strike di Ammonites until di heat of di day: and di ones wey remain scatter, so tay no two of dem remain together.
Di people talk to Samuel say, “Who be di one wey talk say, ‘Saul go reign over us?’ Bring dem men, make we put dem to death.”
Saul talk say, “Nobody go die dis day; because today di Lord don work deliverance for Israel.”
Den Samuel talk to di people say, “Come, make we go Gilgal, and renew di kingdom dere.”

All di people go Gilgal; and dere dem make Saul king before di Lord for Gilgal; and dere dem offer sacrifices of peace offerings before di Lord; and dere Saul and all di men of Israel rejoice greatly.
